reviews.title: Definitely add to cart!

reviews.title: Endless fun for my child and others
reviews.body: I’ve had this bouncy house for a whole year now so I’ve come here to tell you what a great investment it was. I initially purchased this after trying to rent one and finding it would cost me double what this house costs. It has been up at 3 birthday parties now, and kids of all ages (up to 10 years old) enjoy it and we have not had any durability issues with it, even with several kids in there at one time. It brings endless joy to my daughter. Easy to get up, easy to store, have kept it inflated for days at a time with no problem. Netting and fabric all hold up amazingly, house does not lean or fall over, very stable. I feel it is very safe. Easy to clean when our birds friends fly by. My only minor complaint it how difficult it is to dry off when you do use it with water or if it happens to rain on it. Worth noting I have it sitting on top of a heavy duty tarp and I don’t keep it in full sun all day long. But I would but this product again and again.

reviews.title: Definitely recommend!
reviews.body: This bounce house is fantastic. It takes me (mom) 5 minutes to get it all set up and not much longer than that to break it down. My 5 year old and 2 year old love it. It’s the perfect size and has held up great and keep fully inflated without any sagging issues. We’ve had it for a year now.

reviews.title: Money well spent, up in under 30sec,  2 1/2 yr old has a blast!
reviews.body: This is ssssooo worth it!! We got this for our almost 3 yr old (very high energy) and this has done wonders for indoor days! It is quite large so have to move things out of the way, great for a basement or a large room with everything out of the way. Also, if running indoors make sure to open a window where your running it, just has a smell and I can’t quite put my finger on it. Haven’t used outside with water yet but will do that and buy a tarp to go underneath when outdoors. Endless fun and always has a blast when it is blown up.. it goes up in under 30 seconds. Super easy and light (enough) to roll up and put away everyday if needed to. Takes a little time to go down. Overall this was well worth the $220.
